name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, save the kitchen from the pressure of too many orders and keep service going even when the network goes. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the order and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen will be able to cook, then mark the order as “Ready” and “Picked up”.

■ Don’t give a time you can’t keep
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a pickup time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the line keeps pace with the kitchen.

■ Take orders right at the counter
Add walk-in orders on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one line.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen display shows what to make now, what’s next and what’s ready, and alerts you when it’s time to start an order.

■ Print order tickets
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or your local network, and order tickets will print by themselves.

■ Keep service going even when the network goes
Switch on offline protection: when the connection goes, pre-orders are paused, so nobody can place an order you won’t see. Orders taken on the device stay saved and sync when you’re back online.

■ Made just for the food truck
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
